label: History
value: The Wizard ruled the land for many years.
unit: After landing in Oz via balloon, the Wizard was taken for a superior being and commissioned the building of the Emerald City, ruling the land for many years while using illusions to keep his subjects from seeing his true form. When Dorothy Gale arrived seeking a way home, he promised to help her and her companions if they killed the Wicked Witch of the West. Following the Witch's defeat, Dorothy's dog Toto knocked over a screen in the Throne Room, exposing him as an ordinary old man from Omaha and a self-confessed humbug. He nevertheless satisfied Dorothy's companions by providing them with symbolic substitutes for brains, a heart, and courage. He then attempted to escape back to America with Dorothy in a hot-air balloon, but the balloon detached prematurely and carried him off alone. Returning to circus life, he was later swallowed into the subterranean world during an earthquake along with a boy named Zeb, a horse, and Dorothy. Using his sleight-of-hand tricks to impress subterranean inhabitants, he traveled with Dorothy's group until Princess Ozma rescued them using the Magic Belt. Upon returning to the Emerald City, Ozma granted him a permanent home as the Official Wizard of Oz.

label: History
value: Zeb climbed down the prison building using a leather strap
unit: Zeb was driving Jim the Cab-Horse to pick up Dorothy Gale when a severe earthquake hit, swallowing the buggy, horse, and children into a subterranean abyss. Landing in the Land of the Mangaboos, Zeb and Dorothy were accused of causing the Rain of Stones and were brought to the House of the Sorcerer. They met the Wizard of Oz when his balloon descended, but the group was eventually sentenced to doom by the vegetable people and entombed in a mountain cavern. They escaped by driving through the mountain's tunnel into the Valley of Voe, where unseen inhabitants helped them cross a river to avoid invisible bears. Mounting a spiral staircase inside Pyramid Mountain, they reached the wooden Country of the Gargoyles, where they were captured; Zeb climbed down the prison building using a leather strap made from Jim's harness to steal wooden wings, enabling them to fly away. After navigating further dangerous passages, including a cave of dragonettes and a turn-table rock, Dorothy summoned Princess Ozma using a signal, and they were all transported to the Emerald City in the Land of Oz. There, Zeb received grand green clothes, dined with Princess Ozma, participated in athletic games, and served on a court jury. Desiring to return home, Zeb and Jim were transported back to Hugson's Ranch by Princess Ozma's Magic Belt.

His success ended when the yellow hen Billina laid an egg in his throne room—frightening him with what Nomes consider rank poison—and proceeded to guess correctly to disenchant all the captives. After losing his army to thrown eggs, he was forced to let his former prisoners depart and retreat to his throne in defeat.

value: Mombi was forced to drink a potion to strip away all her magic.
unit: Mombi lived in the Country of the Gillikins and acted as guardian to Tip, making him work on her farm while practicing magical arts in secret. Upon acquiring the magic Powder of Life from a wizard, she brought Tip's pumpkin-headed dummy to life. That evening, she attempted to brew a potion to turn Tip into a marble statue, prompting the boy to flee with the Powder of Life and Jack Pumpkinhead. Later, General Jinjur summoned Mombi to help the Army of Revolt defeat the Scarecrow and Tin Woodman. Mombi used magical deceptions and illusions to delay the party, but Glinda the Sorceress eventually marched on the Emerald City and demanded her surrender. Mombi attempted to escape using multiple shape-shifting transformations—including a maiden, a rose, a shadow, an ant, and a griffin—before Glinda captured her with a golden thread. Threatening death, Glinda forced Mombi to confess that she had hidden Princess Ozma by transforming her into the boy Tip. Mombi subsequently performed the magical incantation to break the charm, restoring Ozma to her rightful female form, and was forced to drink a potion to strip away all her magic.

label: History
value: The Wizard rescued Jim.
unit: Jim was born in Kentucky and was once a successful racehorse before spending many hard years drawing a public cab in Chicago. Eventually brought to Hugson's Ranch, he was pulling a buggy for Zeb to meet Dorothy Gale at the train station when an earthquake caused the earth to open up. Jim, the buggy, Zeb, Dorothy, and her kitten Eureka fell deep into the earth, where Jim gained the ability to speak. After floating down into the Land of the Mangaboos, he grazed on rainbow grass but was eventually driven toward the Black Pit along with the other animals. Defending himself and his companions by kicking through ranks of Mangaboos, Jim was trapped in a cave until rescued by the Wizard, after which he hauled the buggy through the subterranean tunnels up into the Valley of Voe. Attacks by invisible bears forced him to run onto a river and later dash to the stairs of the Pyramid Mountain. Ascending to the Country of the Gargoyles, he fought off wooden creatures with his hoofs, and was later fitted with wooden wings to fly the buggy away to safety. Trapped in a dark cavern near a dragon's lair, Jim was transported alongside his companions directly to the Emerald City of Oz by Princess Ozma's Magic Belt. In Oz, he was served uncooked oatmeal, met the Saw-Horse, and engaged in a friendly debate with the Cowardly Lion and Hungry Tiger. He challenged the Saw-Horse to a race but lost, afterwards kicking his wooden rival in anger until humbled by the Tiger and Lion. He served as a juror during Eureka's trial, but feeling out of place in a fairyland, requested to return home, whereupon Ozma transported Jim and Zeb safely back to Hugson's Ranch.

Later, he joined Princess Ozma's court in the Emerald City as her faithful vassal and chariot-puller alongside his close friend, the Hungry Tiger. label: History
value: Tiktok defended Billina against the Wheelers.
unit: Tiktok was manufactured by the inventors Smith & Tinker in Ev-na and served King Evoldo of Ev, who named him after the ticking sound of his clockwork. After being locked away in a rocky cavern in Ev, he was found and wound up by Dorothy Gale. He defended Dorothy and Billina against the Wheelers and helped them enter the palace of Ev. When Princess Langwidere ordered Dorothy imprisoned, Tiktok defended her until his action clockwork ran down, leaving him immobilized in the drawing-room. He was found by Princess Ozma's party, rewound by Dorothy, and joined the expedition to rescue the royal family of Ev from the Nome King. During the journey, he safely stepped past the Nome King's giant iron hammer and faced the Nome King's guessing game in the underground palace, where he was transformed into a golden ornament. After Billina freed the party, Tiktok was restored to his normal form and accompanied Ozma and Dorothy to the Emerald City. Because he could not function in a non-fairy country, Dorothy left him in Ozma's care in the Land of Oz.

label: History
value: The Saw-Horse reached Glinda the Good.
unit: The Saw-Horse was brought to life when Tip sprinkled it with the magic Powder of Life and recited Mombi's incantation. After Tip whittled wooden ears and attached them to its head, the creature was able to hear and learned basic commands like 'Whoa' and 'Get-Up'. It served as a mount for Jack Pumpkinhead on their journey to the Emerald City, easily carrying him over land and floating across rivers. When General Jinjur's rebels took the city, the Saw-Horse carried Tip, the Scarecrow, and Jack Pumpkinhead in a wild escape to seek the help of the Tin Woodman. Later, after breaking a leg in a rabbit hole, its leg was replaced with one taken from Jack Pumpkinhead. It accompanied the party through various trials, including an attack by Jackdaws, until they reached Glinda the Good. The Saw-Horse demonstrated its extraordinary speed by relentlessly pursuing Mombi across the desert when she turned into a Griffin until she collapsed from exhaustion. After Princess Ozma took her rightful place as ruler, the Saw-Horse became her personal property, living in the palace and having its feet shod with gold plates to prevent them from wearing out. During Ozma's expedition to the Land of Ev, the Scarecrow rode the Saw-Horse across the desert on the magic carpet. Later, back in the Emerald City, it met Jim the cab-horse, conversed with him about their differences, and easily defeated Jim in a footrace, after which Jim angrily kicked and damaged it before being tackled by the Hungry Tiger. Following the trial of Eureka the kitten, the Saw-Horse served as one of the nine members of the jury.

label: History
value: Tip brought a wooden Saw-Horse to life.
unit: Jack Pumpkinhead was carved and built out of wood and a pumpkin by a boy named Tip in order to frighten the witch Mombi. Upon discovering him, Mombi used her newly acquired Powder of Life to bring Jack to life. When Mombi threatened Tip, the boy escaped at night and took Jack with him, with Jack adopting Tip as his father and creator. On their journey toward the Emerald City, Tip brought a wooden Saw-Horse to life so Jack could ride it and spare his jointed legs. After being separated from Tip during a wild run by the Saw-Horse, Jack arrived at the Emerald City alone, met the Guardian of the Gates, and was brought before His Majesty the Scarecrow, with whom he became fast friends. When General Jinjur and her Army of Revolt conquered the city, Jack escaped with Tip, the Scarecrow, and the Saw-Horse on the wooden horse's back. During their river crossing, Jack's pumpkin head fell off and floated away, but Tip salvaged it and put it back on his neck. The group traveled to the Winkie Country to seek help from the Tin Woodman, during which Jack had his left leg whittled down to replace a broken leg on the Saw-Horse, later receiving a carved mahogany table leg as a replacement. After fleeing the Emerald City on the flying Gump machine, landing in a Jackdaw nest, and being rescued, they joined Glinda the Good. They returned to the Emerald City, where Mombi was forced to restore Princess Ozma. Jack remained in the Emerald City with Ozma for the rest of his days, continuing his duties and participating in royal events like reading a congratulatory address upon Ozma's return from a rescue mission.
